item.title: All sprites in the Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season
item.description: Sprites have taken over another season with their inclusion in the Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season, " Treasure Hunters ." These sprites work functionally the same way as they did in the last seasons: find them around the island, level them up, and extract them to master them. Mastering sprites will unlock different rewards, like sprite dust and cosmetics.

item.title: Where to find the Fast & Furious Mitsubishi Eclipse in GTA 6
item.description: In GTA 6 , Brian O'Conner's green Mitsubishi Eclipse from the first Fast & Furious movie can be yours if you know where to look. The car is a direct reference to the one we see Paul Walker's character driving early in the movie. It's a pretty fast car that can help you to quickly traverse the map and escape the police. Considering how good this car is, it's surprisingly easy to rob, making it a perfect special car to look for early in the game — as long as you have the funds to keep it for yourself .

item.title: GTA 6 Parody In Binding of Isaac Used AI Without Creator's Knowledge
item.description: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance Plus was recently at the center of gaming's latest generative AI controversy. Creator Edmund McMillen claimed music made with generative AI was used without his knowledge for a new daily run riffing on Grand Theft Auto 6 . Repentance Plus was released in full on Nov. 19 alongside its new console ports.

item.title: GTA 6 Could Actually Lose at Least 3 Game Awards Categories
item.description: After racking up an astonishing 99 rating on Metacritic — officially the highest ever — Grand Theft Auto 6 is more than the favorite to win Game of the Year at The Game Awards on Dec. 10. It's a certainty.

item.title: GTA 6 Players Keep Discovering Ridiculous New Ways To Steal Money
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is such a vast game full of incredible little details and ways to interact with its massive world. Days after its release, players are still finding new ways to steal and make money , including by ripping an ATM right out of the wall.

item.title: GTA 6 Makes It Nearly Impossible to Play Without Killing Anyone
item.description: I tried not to kill anyone in Grand Theft Auto 6 and failed. However, it changed the way I thought about and approached the game's violence.

item.title: 30 Years Later, Sean Connery's Secret James Bond Thriller Is Officially Free on Streaming
item.description: Back in the 1990s, Michael Bay was really cooking. Before the slog that was 2001’s Pearl Harbor and his divisive Transformers movies that simultaneously hurt and enhanced his career by sidelining him for decades, Bay debuted as a director with a trio of really exciting movies that prioritized a fun experience for the viewer. First there was 1995’s Bad Boys , the Will Smith and Martin Lawrence buddy-cop film that became a popular franchise. He closed out the decade with the genre-defining end-of-the-world disaster film Armageddon . And in between those two, he gave us a tightly crafted thriller that is currently free to stream (with ads) on Pluto TV.

item.title: Star Wars’ 2-Part Sci-Fi War Thriller Has One of the Best Seasons in TV History
item.description: In 2022, Disney was having a pretty strange year with its franchises. There were some major wins, such as the hugely financially successful release of Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness and Turning Red becoming a streaming hit. Its films also earned $4.9 billion at the box office that year.

item.title: 8 Best Science Fantasy Books of the 21st Century
item.description: The legendary science fiction writer Arthur C. Clarke once said, “Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic.” The lines between sci-fi and fantasy blur in popular entertainment franchises like Star Wars , Warhammer 40,000 , and the Marvel Cinematic Universe , as well as in classic book series like Dune and Dragonriders of Pern. If you’re looking for a new world to explore and can’t decide if you want it filled with spaceships or dragons, you don’t necessarily have to choose. Just pick something from this list of the best science fantasy books of the 21st century.
